page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a running head at top and page number at top right. Entries are set as hanging paragraphs in one column, with Hebrew, Chaldaic, Syriac and Greek words inline. No margin notes. A catchword stands at the lower right.

main_text.p: Esth.9.5. idem quod גּוּלְפִין litteris homogeneis permutatis.
גּוּלְמִיש גַּלְמִיש Ch. Species cedri: Quidam Corallium interpretantur, Cantic.1.17. Plur. גַּלְמֵשִין Cedri, Cantic.5.15.
גַּלְם מוּגְלְסְיָא Ch. Cardines, aut ferramenta januarū cava, 1.Reg.7.50. Respondet Hebraeo פּוֹתוֹת.
גְּלוֹסְקְמָא Ch. Arca, Capsa, Feretrum, Genef.50.v.ult. in Targ. Jonath. & Hierof. Item Syr. Loculus, Marsupium, [?] Et marsupium penes eum erat, Johan.12.6. & 13.29. Est ex Graeco γλωσσόκομον.
גְּלַף Ch. Sculpsit, exsculpsit, insculpsit, cælavit. Affine est Graec. γλύφω. Syr. [illegible, ~8 letters] Lapidi sculpto per artem. Act.17.29.
גְּלִיפָא, גְּלִיף, גְּלַף Ch. Sculptum: Sculptura. Plur. cum Affixo גְּלִיפֵיהָא Sculpturas ejus, Pf.74.6.
גּוּלְפִין Ch. Armorum genus, forte idē quod קוֹלְפִין Clavae, vel כּוֹלְבִין, Esth.9.5.
אַגְלִפּוּת Ch. Sculptura, Exod.31.5. & 35.33. in Jon.
גְּלוֹפְקְרָא Ch. Stragula, stramentum crassum, laneum & villosum, Deut.24.13. in Jon. Idē quod שְׁמִיכָה Heb. juxta Kimchium, Judic.4.18.
גְּלַשׁ גְּלוּשׁ Ch. Calvus, Recalvaster, Levit.13.4.1. Respondet Hebraeo גַּבַּח.
גְּלְשְׁלְשָׁן C. Idem, Ibid. in Jonath.

page.notes: Syriac and Hebrew vowel points are approximated; the Syriac words after "Syr." on the line for "Affine est" and after "Marsupium" are only partly legible on the scan. The Hebrew word at line end after "Locus calvus" is printed alone at the lower right and is treated as the catchword.
